title: Playing with syllables
summary: Practise reading and joining Spanish syllables to make words.
keyIdeas: A syllable groups sounds into one spoken beat.
Joining syllables makes whole words, such as lu-na and pe-lo-ta.
Reading each syllable slowly can help you understand a text.

basicKnowledge: D. Reflexión sobre la lengua y sus usos en el marco de propuestas la producción y comprensión de textos orales, escritos o multimodales

activities.prompt: Which Spanish word do «ca» and «sa» make together? 🏠
activities.explanation: Ca followed by sa makes casa.
activities.hint: Read the two parts in order.

activities.prompt: The Spanish word «sol» has two syllables.
activities.explanation: Sol is said in one spoken beat, so it has one syllable.

activities.prompt: Choose the missing syllable to complete the Spanish animal name. 🐸
activities.explanation: Po completes sapo, the Spanish word for a toad.
activities.sentence: El animal del charco es un sa___.

activities.prompt: Join the syllables to make «mesa», «libro», «lápiz» and «goma».
activities.explanation: The matched syllables form mesa, libro, lápiz and goma.

activities.prompt: Sort these Spanish words by their number of syllables.
activities.explanation: Clap each syllable: lu-na, bar-co and pe-rro have two; pe-lo-ta, co-mi-da and to-ma-te have three.

activities.prompt: Put the syllables in order to write a fruit's Spanish name. 🍌
Aisha wants a fruit whose Spanish name starts with «man-». Which does she ask for? 🍎
activities.explanation: Manzana starts with man-. Pera starts with pe-, and plátano with plá-.
activities.hint: Look for the word starting with m.

activities.prompt: Choose the syllable that completes the Spanish sentence.
activities.explanation: The correct word is maleta: ma-le-ta.
activities.sentence: Nerea guarda su ropa en la ma___ta.

activities.prompt: Read the Spanish text carefully and answer the questions.
activities.explanation: Reading each syllable helps us understand Tito's story.
activities.title: El gato Tito
activities.text: El gato Tito sube a la te-ja. Mira una ma-ri-po-sa a-zul. La ma-ri-po-sa vuela alto. Tito baja a su cu-na y se duerme fe-liz.

questions.prompt: Where does Tito the cat climb?
questions.explanation: The text says El gato Tito sube a la te-ja.

questions.prompt: Which Spanish colour word describes the butterfly Tito sees?
questions.explanation: The text says the butterfly is azul, meaning blue.
